values.note: Not reservable: recreation.gov lists Carbella Rec Site (facility 261814) as an information-only, non-reservable facility, and the BLM page names no booking. Through Dec 31, 2026 a BLM order allows hard-sided camping units only, because of grizzly activity.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search?q=Carbella (entity 261814, entity_type facility, reservable false) + https://www.blm.gov/visit/carbella-rec-site ('a temporary order restricting camping at the Carbella Recreation Site in Park County to hard-sided camping units only through Dec. 31, 2026, due to ongoing grizzly bear activity'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM developed campground on the upper Yellowstone River near Emigrant; numbered drive-in sites in a single line along the riverbank, each with table, fire ring and food-storage locker. Roads suitable for any vehicle. Note: through Dec 31 2026 a BLM order limits camping to hard-sided units only (grizzly activity) — EKKO qualifies. --Claude
summary: BLM page: confirmed $15/night per campsite (Apr 1 - Nov 30 fee period; fees already checked 2026-10-16) and the hard-sided-only grizzly order through 2026-12-31. Recorded not reservable (recreation.gov lists it as a non-reservable facility), overriding the inherited federal recreation.gov booking. The page does not state a site count, toilet type, campground season (the date range is only the fee period) or discounts; left as they were. Note trimmed of restated fee/season/site-count/toilet text.
